purpose: Recover constituent exposure names and current processing metadata from primary FITS headers, without image pixel acquisition or photometry.
source: Frozen MAST CAOM visit-groups.csv public data_uri
selection: All remaining six pre-identified source/template associations, no selection using pixel values. Initial two header outcomes known; no image pixels read.
method: Official MAST Download/file GET with Range bytes0-287999; stream only2880byte FITS blocks through PRIMARY END. Close immediately; preserve responsemetadata and received primaryheader. Even ifRangeignored, no scienceextensionread.
limitations: Current pipeline products need not equal historical RAISIN processing. Headerprocessing evidence is not calibrationexecution proof or actualphotometry.
